100+ Supported Industries

We accept a wide range of industries.

TailoredPay stands out from popular payment processing alternatives (PayPal, Stripe, Square, etc) by catering specifically to businesses operating in high risk industries.

Don’t see your industry listed?

Call (888) 599-6482 and find out if
your industry is supported.

  • Credit Repair

  • Psychics

  • Web Design/Hosting

  • Travel

  • Business Consulting

  • Large Ticket Accounts

  • Online Dating

  • Prop Firms

  • Collection Agencies

  • Nutraceutical

  • Recurring Billing

  • Jewelry

  • Telemedicine

  • Software & eBook

  • E-Cig/Vape

  • Online Furniture

  • Moving & Transportation

  • SEO/SEM

  • Dropshipping

  • Lending

  • Identity Theft Protection

How It Works

High risk merchant account setups in 3 easy steps:

(888) 599-6482

Apply for a high risk merchant account in under 10 minutes and get an instant quote.

Apply Now
Apply online within minutes

It takes less than 10 minutes to complete our secure application and upload supporting documents.

Get an instant quote

An expert underwriter will review your application and set a processing limit. We keep you posted with daily updates.

Start processing

Our merchant support team will help you set up the payment gateway, so you can start accepting payments immediately.

Discover why so many businesses trust TailoredPay with their payment processing needs.
